description: This walk follows the South West Coast Path from Morwenstow to Bude. It's about an 8 mile walk along a lovely section of the coastal path. Along the way there's wonderful cliff top views, lovely beaches and interesting rock formations to see. You can start the walk from the car park at the Church of St Morwenna and St John the Baptist in Morwenstow. From here you head west to meet up with the coast path.The path heads south passing the headland at Sharpnose Point and the lovely National Trust's Sandymouth Beach. The beach is a nice place for a pit stop with a good cafe for refreshments.The final sections takes you along a series of Bude's beaches before crossing the River Neet and arriving in Bude. Here you can continue your walking atBude Marshesand along theBude Canal.
